featured_reviews.review_text:
I highly recommend Health Bag Meal tiffin service! I ordered their tiffins for a month during a time when my husband and I were down with chicken gunya, and our cook was on long leave. Health Bag Meal truly was a lifesaver.

The food is hygienic, non-spicy, and absolutely delicious. Everything is delivered right to your doorstep in sealed bags, so there’s no spilling, mixing, or misplacement. The containers are microwave-safe, making it very convenient to reheat.

What impressed me most is the variety in the menu — no dish was repeated over the entire month! They also don’t use baking powder or baking soda, and we had zero digestion issues. The variety of vegetables and dals was particularly commendable.

Mr. Harish Sharma, the owner, is very courteous, always responds promptly and addresses the queries satisfactorily. On request, he provided vegetables without onion and garlic for my parents, and they loved them. On one occasion, there was a small mix-up in the order, but he promptly sent the correct vegetables again at no extra charge — a truly heartwarming gesture.

Overall, Health Bag Meal combines user-friendly, hygiene, and delicious home-style food with excellent customer service. I’ve already recommended them to many and I will continue to do so!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

featured_reviews.name: Jonatas Castro
featured_reviews.review_text: Eager To Eat is a homely made food that's apt for everybody. The quantity is good and the taste is fine too. I would recommend everyone to try ones if they are looking for homemade food at their doorstep. Keep up the good taste. Eager to Eat!!!

featured_reviews.name: Amruta Ghayal
featured_reviews.review_text: Tasty and healthy food with a lot of variety. Portion size is decent and the food is really good. They also serve multiple additional items from time to time which is a wonderful surprise. During festivals they also provide sweets with the tiffins without additional costs. We have been having tiffins from them for almost a year now and they have never disappointed us. Their delivery service promptness and overall logistics is also commendable. We highly recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: Yoganand Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: After trying many tiffin services over the years, I found this service to provide food which taste like home food... vegetables are good..chappatis are soft... I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a healthy and tasty food... thanks Eager to Eat

featured_reviews.name: Amrita Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Timely service and good variety of options. Thank you Eager to Eat. We were looking for an all vegetarian kitchen and this suits us perfectly. The quality of food is also fine.

Suggestions: If you could reduce the chilli and spice level in the summers that would suit all
especially children, senior citizens and people with health issues. Or if you could also include a separate meal plan keeping the above in mind, you could reach out to more customers for sure.
The interface for booking orders could also include a drop down tab for quantity or number of units. For instance 2 standard meal B.
Thank you and all the best!

featured_reviews.name: Uday Pullela
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been taking meals from Eager to eat for close to 2 months. The best feature i love about them is the variety of curries they serve with roti and rice. The balance is well maintained.  The portion size is good enough to satiate hunger for at least 4 hours.

featured_reviews.name: Hoshedar
featured_reviews.review_text:
They deliver properly packed delicious, home-made and hygienic food... It's a complete package of quantity, quality, taste and PRICE!

My mom is having this tiffin since past one year and she is loving it as their menu changes daily and their main usp is they use cold compress oil in cooking which is very very healthy to consume..

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Nisal
featured_reviews.review_text: I had been order from eager to eat since the last few months and I have to say it they are really punctual and we always get our food on time... food tastes good and is healthy as well as there is less oil... I would definitely recommend eager to eat to anyone who is looking for a healthy home cooked food 🙂👍🏼
